title: SB509 (2025 Regular): Prohibited Possession of Firearms - Assisted Outpatient Treatment Respondents

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2025RS/bills/sb/sb0509f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (as filed). Health-General § 10-6A-02(b) change is only a cross-reference. Takes effect contingent on Chapter 704 of 2024.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-133(b)(16)): (16) IS CURRENTLY A RESPONDENT SUBJECT TO A COURT ORDER TO COMPLY WITH ASSISTED OUTPATIENT TREATMENT UNDER § 10–6A–08 OF THE HEALTH – GENERAL ARTICLE.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-133.2(b)(1)(iv)): (IV) ORDERS A PERSON TO COMPLY WITH ASSISTED OUTPATIENT TREATMENT UNDER § 10–6A–08 OF THE HEALTH – GENERAL ARTICLE.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-205(b)(14)): (14) IS CURRENTLY A RESPONDENT SUBJECT TO A COURT ORDER TO COMPLY WITH ASSISTED OUTPATIENT TREATMENT UNDER § 10–6A–08 OF THE HEALTH – GENERAL ARTICLE.
